info.title: Phober Config Server API
info.description: Serves runtime configuration (feature flags, cross-service settings) that every other service pulls at boot via the shared ConfigClient. Reached externally via https://api.phober.test/configs/*. Read-only — config entries are created/edited exclusively through Nova in adminpanel, not via this API.

get.description: Unauthenticated, unfiltered, unpaginated. Called by every service's ConfigClient::update() at boot/deploy to rebuild .env.shared. Optionally cached server-side for 5 minutes when USE_CACHE=true.

200.description: OK — flat object of every config row, key to value (both strings). Empty object if no rows exist.

get.description: Registered by every service via the shared package (drives the config-client:update artisan command). Since config-server itself also loads the shared package, this endpoint exists on config-server too, even though it would be pulling config-server's own data.
